text:
Nina: Meridian asks about a migration PoC from CompetitorX -> Redwood. Main asks: request/response parity, a quick security checklist, and a PoC pricing stub. Can we outline?
Marco: I can own the adapter shim and parity tests. Ask them for 350 representative prompts across intents (chat, summarize, extraction).
Sophie: Share their security questionnaire here. Key items we'll need to answer: KMS support, retention policy, access logs, and whether we support customer-managed keys.
Nina: Uploaded secq link in DM to Sophie. Legal flagged data residency and indemnity as potential blockers.
Dylan: Infra note: they want an isolated PoC pool with outbound egress blocked except to their IP list. I can do that but need CIDR and contact. ETA ~36 hours to spin up once we have details.
Marco: Testing plan: 1) small proxy to accept CompetitorX payloads and map headers/body, 2) run blind A/B for 350 prompts, 3) collect outputs, token counts, and a simple lexical similarity score, 4) produce a delta report with examples and severity buckets.
Sophie: Security checklist answers: default retention 30 days, deletion on request within 48 hours, SOC2 Type II in place (can share redacted report), and we support customer KMS via KMS integration. Will prepare artifacts.
Nina: Pricing: propose a 45-day PoC blended rate with a committed token bucket and an overage clause. Dylan, what capacity should we reserve?
Dylan: For 350 prompts run and some smoke traffic, a small dedicated pool (2 GPUs) should be fine. Recommend scaling if they run heavy concurrency.
ops-bot: [provision] meridian-poc queued by dylan_ops  36h ETA for IP allocation.
Marco: I'll post the eval harness repo and a minimal runbook (how to run A/B, expected CSV) before kickoff. Need their prompts and a test key to start.
Nina: OK let's schedule a 30min pre-kickoff tomorrow to triage secq and CIDR. Thanks team.
